title: Parallel routing lanes: feedback cycles and fan-out / merge
summary: Geometry-only fixture for the reported 15-node / 24-relationship readability regression. The lanes, branches and feedback connections are synthetic routing examples, not documentation of the current runtime or delegation API. Historical filenames and graph IDs remain stable for regression assertions; node kinds, relationship kinds and topology are retained to exercise layout and routing.
